# v0.4.1 — Media context menu, whole thumbnails and application icons

## "..." menu on every gallery item

Each media tile gains a context menu with three actions:

- **View** — opens the file with the system's default viewer
- **Copy to…** — native folder picker, then a collision-safe copy
  (`photo.jpg`, `photo (1).jpg`, …)
- **Move to…** — the same picker, moving the file across volumes too
  (WSL home ↔ `/mnt/c` falls back to copy + delete when rename cannot
  cross filesystems). Moved files leave the gallery and the findings list

The menu closes on outside click, action or Escape — Escape closes the
menu before the gallery.

## Thumbnails show the whole image

Tiles cropped previews to a centered square before; images now fit
entirely inside the tile.

## Applications show real icons

The Applications page resolves each app's icon — `.desktop` `Icon=`
values through the hicolor theme on Linux (largest size first, pixmap
fallback), standalone `.ico`/`.png` `DisplayIcon` files on Windows — and
falls back to the letter glyph when nothing resolves.

## Windows: the "never used" column actually works now

UserAssist, the source of last-used times, records GUI launches by their
**Start Menu shortcut** (`google chrome.lnk`) — not by the executable. The
old matcher compared only executable paths, so every app resolved to
"Never / unknown". Matching now also compares normalized shortcut stems
against the app's display name and takes the newest matching timestamp.
